newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom 9-mth profit up on rising volume.
newsitem.headline: Telkom 9-mth profit up on rising volume.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Wednesday net profit in the first nine months of 1996 rose due to an increase in the number of telephone lines and telephone calls.
Telkom said it posted a net profit of 1.13 trillion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 878.4 billion rupiah in the same 1995 period.
"The increase was largely attributable to the company's continued growth in the number of lines in service and corresponding increased call volume on the fixed line network," it said in a statement.
For the first nine months of 1996, Telkom added some 628,447 lines compared to 511,611 during the same period of last year, it said.
As of September 30, 1996, Telkom had a total of 3.92 million lines in service, an increase of 32 percent over 2.97 million in the same period last year.
